name: Garlic & Herb Focaccia with Roasted Garlic Dip (Night 1 Bread Service)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · Animator's Palate
whyItWorks: Soft olive-oil white focaccia bread is seed-free and easy to chew; the accompanying roasted garlic dip is the main FODMAP item.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the plain white rolls in the basket or brush off rosemary needles from the focaccia, and skip the concentrated roasted garlic dip.
watchOuts: Concentrated garlic fructans in the dip
Woody rosemary needles on focaccia crust
